title: Tortoise Finds His Home
summary: Tortoise sets out to look for his home, and along the way he meets new friends who join in to help. But the sky grows dark and a storm is coming. Will Tortoise find his home in time?
pages:
One day Tortoise was walking across the grassland.
He looked and looked. He gazed far, far away and squinted at the grass.
"Looking for something?" asked Snail.
"Yes, I'm looking for my home. Have you seen it?"

"No, I haven't, but I'll help you look!"
She climbed onto Tortoise's shell. Tortoise kept walking with Snail on his back.
They looked and looked, but there was no home anywhere.

"Looking for something?" asked Sparrow.
"Yes, we're looking for Tortoise's home. Have you seen it?"
"No, I haven't, but I'll help you look!"

Sparrow flapped his wings and zoomed off.
"You're too fast!" called Tortoise.
"All right, then I'll climb on too."
Tortoise kept walking with Snail and Sparrow on his shell. They looked and looked, but there was no home anywhere.

"Looking for something?" asked Beetle.
"Yes, we're looking for Tortoise's home. Have you seen it?"

"No, I haven't, but I'll help you look!"
Beetle hopped onto Tortoise's shell. Tortoise kept walking with Snail and Sparrow and Beetle on his back.
They looked and looked, but there was no home anywhere.
A light wind began to blow.

"Looking for something?" asked Mouse.
"Yes, Mouse, I'm looking for my home. Have you seen it?"
"No, I haven't, but I'll help you look!"

Mouse jumped onto Tortoise's back.
Tortoise kept walking with Snail and Sparrow and Beetle and Mouse on his back.
They looked and looked, but there was no home anywhere.
The wind blew the leaves off the ground and whirled them around Tortoise.

The wind grew stronger and stronger. The sky turned dark.
"Oh, where is my home?" sighed Tortoise.
Thunder rumbled over the hills. Lightning flashed far away. Drip, drip, the rain began to fall.
"Oh, where is Tortoise's home?" asked Snail and Sparrow and Beetle and Mouse.
The wind swirled and whistled and blew Snail and Sparrow and Beetle and Mouse right off Tortoise's back.

"Help!" squealed Tortoise in fright, and he pulled himself into his shell.
Inside it was warm and cozy.
"Oh, here is my home!"
